name: BIM × AI Integration Deck
tagline: Two ladders: how BIM maturity and AI capability climb together.

page.objective: Show where the studio sits on both the BIM and the AI ladder, and what the next rung costs.
page.problem: BIM maturity and AI capability were being discussed as separate conversations.
page.solution: One deck that puts the two ladders side by side, so each AI step is tied to the BIM step it depends on.
